description: List this organization's processes (SOPs written on agent seats) together with any schedules already attached to them. Use this BEFORE creating, changing, or running a schedule: it is the only place the real agent externalId and SOP title come from, and both are required by the other process tools. The response also tells you whether autonomous runs are currently armed for the deployment (schedulerArmed) and whether this org is allowed to schedule at all (gate). Never guess an externalId or a SOP title; if this returns nothing, the org has no processes to schedule yet.
name: list_processes
